industria.title: Industry
industria.description: Answer these small but important questions to discover which profile suits you best and what role you could play in the industry of the future.

intro.subtitle: What could you bring to the industry of the future?
intro.body: Answer these small but important questions to discover which profile suits you best and what role you could play in the industry of the future.

industria.shareText: My profile in the industry of the future: {profile}. What's yours?

questions.likelyJob: I'm likely to end up working in Basque industry.
questions.wantCareer: I want to build my career in Basque industry.
questions.goodSalary: If I worked in the industrial sector, I would earn a good salary.
questions.stableJob: If I worked in the industrial sector, I would have a stable job with opportunities for career progression.
questions.fun: If I worked in the industrial sector, I would enjoy my job.
questions.creative: Basque industry is a sector where I could be creative.
questions.informed: I know what career opportunities are available in Basque industry.
questions.basqueRequired: Speaking Basque is a requirement for getting a job in the sector.
questions.meritOnly: Getting a job in industry depends only on your skills and achievements; who you know doesn't matter.
questions.manualOnly: Only manual workers and specialised technicians can work in Basque industry.
questions.socialSciences: There is no place for people with social sciences degrees in Basque industry.
questions.masculine: Basque industry is a very male-dominated sector.
questions.localOwners: The owners of industrial companies in the Basque Country are from the Basque Country.
questions.modern: Basque industry is very modern and uses the latest technologies.
questions.wellbeing: Basque industry produces goods that improve our well-being.
questions.pollution: Basque industry is responsible for a large share of pollution in the Basque Country.
questions.innovation: Basque industry and its research drive innovations that improve people's lives.

imagina.name: Imagine
imagina.headline: You see industry as a space for creativity.
imagina.body: You believe industry can be about much more than manufacturing products. You see it as a place to explore ideas, develop your creativity and find new ways of doing things.
imagina.gaze: Your perspective connects industry with creativity and future possibilities.

proyecta.name: Envision
proyecta.headline: You see industry as a place to build your future.
proyecta.body: For you, industry offers opportunities for professional development. You value the chance to find a stable job, grow in your career and build a life for yourself.
proyecta.gaze: Your perspective connects industry with opportunity and stability.

innova.name: Innovate
innova.headline: You see industry as a driving force for new possibilities.
innova.body: You associate industry with technology, research and advances that transform the world around us. For you, its future lies in developing solutions we are only just beginning to imagine.
innova.gaze: Your perspective connects industry with knowledge and technological innovation.

transforma.name: Transform
transforma.headline: You see industry as a way to improve society.
transforma.body: You recognise its ability to improve well-being and develop innovations that make our lives better. For you, the value of industry also lies in what it contributes to people's lives.
transforma.gaze: Your perspective connects industry with well-being and social impact.
